title: Studio package-create UX dogfood follow-ups (2026-07 browser walkthrough)
body:
Tracking issue for the Studio **package create / edit / view** dogfood walkthrough (2026-07). Records what shipped and the remaining minor items.

## Shipped
- ✅ **Duplicate package id silently overwrites** → `POST /packages` now 409s on an existing id (with `overwrite` escape hatch). framework#2971
- ✅ **Two divergent create UIs / id-regex split** → unified onto the spec-driven `PackageFormDialog` (create/edit/view in a modal, form generated from `ManifestSchema`). #2535
- ✅ **Dead code cleanup** from the form migration. #2540
- ✅ **`PATCH /packages/:id` route was never mounted** (edit silently 405'd) → route registered. framework#2995
- ✅ **Builder top-bar name stale after rename** → switcher refetches on `objectui:packages-changed`. #2554
- ✅ **Forced "New Object" modal on every package create** → auto-open removed; the empty-state panel now carries an opt-in "New object" CTA (hidden on read-only packages). #2569
- ✅ **Mixed-locale rendering in one session** → metadata-admin now follows the live app language via `useMetadataLocale()` (was reading `navigator.language` only), so Studio tracks the LocaleSwitcher instead of diverging from the console. #2602
- ✅ **(future-proof) SDK `client.packages.install()` `overwrite`** → added to the options bag, symmetric with the 409 endpoint. framework#3007

All follow-ups shipped — closing.

_Environmental (not app bugs): the in-app preview browser intermittently `chrome-error`d on direct `/studio` navigation._
